summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the confidential data drops, find what the launch plan hides, and build a general product that notices, shows, acts and learns, with a demo and hand-in at Sunday 12:00.
summary.outcome: Found that Soony's plan says all ok while the Collector's Edition (art books, statues) and Standard (game cards, clear cases) miss Sunday 20:00. Built and deployed the ask_soony product (poller, versioned store, agents, Today/Launch views, routines, supplier email actions, sign-off loop, demo instance). The branch jonas/today-flow was pushed to 4bb8b39 with 2 more local commits; the demo hostname error 1033 and favicon change were still being fixed.

repo: Portal API has only GET /files, /files/{path} and /archive.zip, with no webhook or notification endpoint. Files are replaced under the same name, so the poller must compare SHA-256 checksums, not just filenames.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ and .env; .env.example is committed. Entire only writes checkpoints once repo files change, and its hooks push checkpoints with git push.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist; tasks are claimed in PROGRESS.md.
Prepared routine proposals must expire when their case is decided and be deduplicated across routines; otherwise 'Do all' fails with 'not an open card'.
Routine option matching used the literal text 'make po,rev'; it must match 'make po' and 'rev' separately. Routines also mark cases 'seen' on first run, so they will not retry a case on their own.
The shared mailbox sync wrote back a stale copy of the action log and lost records made in the meantime (the art book van approval record). It now appends under the shared lock, with a test.
A decided case in Today also marked the first 'Needs you' row as selected, so the list jumped to the top. Fixed in the baeb717 list-position fix.
The demo instance (scripts/demo.sh reset|snapshot|stop) runs dry mail mode, which records outbound mail in data/demo/state/dry_outbox.json. Mailbox sync, Teams and portal polling are off there.

Sign-off loop: signoff.py, OkPage.tsx and the /ok/<token> route, with basic_auth.py letting valid links through. ASK_SIGNOFF_SIMULATE=<seconds> auto-approves for the demo and is off by default. Push goes to every subscribed device, with no per-person targeting.
ASK_TEAMS_WEBHOOK is empty in .env, so Teams messages are not sent.
workflow: Subagents are effective for bulk cross-checks (200 order confirmations plus 59 scans) and for parallel builder tasks while the main thread writes docs.
Keep confidential data local and out of docs, commits and outside services; the README for the jury excludes challenge numbers.
Verify UI changes in a real browser by measuring scroll position and taking screenshots, rather than trusting type checks.
Real outbound actions such as supplier emails need a dry-run or demo instance for rehearsal, and the live instance must stay untouched.
Cloudflare tunnel DNS routes must be attached to the correct tunnel; the first attempt for the demo host used the wrong tunnel.

friction: Portal token was empty at the start, blocking data access until it was supplied.

Hidden data traps: a receipt overbooked 72,000 art books, a failed statue lot booked as unrestricted, conflicting sleeve revisions B and C, and a false magnet alarm, all requiring cross-checking of scans against SAP.
Routines could appear switched on but not run ('not run yet'); fixed by running on enable and save.
Approved escalations and internal messages were only recorded, not delivered, while the UI claimed 'DC site lead has it now'.
The art book approval record was lost to the mailbox sync race.
PackRight received duplicate rev C requests after already answering.
Demo hostname returned Cloudflare Error 1033 after the first DNS attempt used the wrong tunnel.
Duplicate 'Ask Hamburg to count book stock' routines caused doubled count questions.
The top bar showed 'nothing needs you' while 4 waiting steps existed, and Maren's view still counts Felix's list.
open_items: Push the 2 local commits (dry-mail switch, demo script) and re-verify that the demo hostname resolves after the favicon change.
Write the 3-minute demo script, record the video and prepare the pitch outline before the 12:00 hand-in.
Add a 'What still saves it' section on Launch (latest arrival per blocker, about 900 copies per hour of delay); prepare the question for Felix about getting container NHSU4471921 to the DC.
Delete the duplicate routine 'Ask Hamburg to count book stock'.
Set up the Teams webhook (ASK_TEAMS_WEBHOOK) and per-person push routing; Undo does not recall a sent push.
Fix the top bar so Maren's view does not say 'nothing needs you'; decide whether to combine the four count questions into one case.
Register sender addresses in the portal Settings and confirm with Lio whether portal data is identical across teams.
Rotate the portal password that appeared in Discord chat history after the hack.
Delete the earlier Claude doc if it is no longer needed, and update the briefing page for the 14:37 drop.
